# Support

## How to file issues and get help

This project uses [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/microsoft/rampart-examples/issues)
to track bugs and feature requests. Please search existing issues
before filing a new one to avoid duplicates.

When opening an issue, include:

- Which demo and which step you were on.
- Python version, OS, and whether you used `uv` or `pip`.
- The error message and the minimum steps to reproduce.

For framework-level questions about RAMPART itself (not specific to a
demo here), please file at [microsoft/RAMPART](https://github.com/microsoft/RAMPART/issues).

## Microsoft Support Policy

Support for this project is limited to the resources listed above.
